name: Judging One Another
overview: Scripture instructs believers to refrain from condemning others, emphasizing that judgment reserved for God should be exercised with humility and righteousness. Jesus teaches not to judge lest we be judged in return, urging forgiveness instead of condemnation. He further warns against hypocritical judgment by highlighting that only those without sin may rightly judge others. Paul reinforces this by reminding believers that judging others while committing similar sins brings self-condemnation and that ultimately, each servant stands or falls before their own Master, God.
